user.title: Add Zonentra
user.description: Like Versatile Thermostat: first create the central configuration (building, outdoor unit groups and shared settings) once, then add every zone separately. Zonentra sets the outdoor unit stand per group; a room is only regulated once its Room regulation switch is on.

central.title: Central configuration
central.description: Building-wide settings used by every zone that takes the central values. Add outdoor unit groups afterwards via Configure. The room regulation settings only apply to rooms whose Room regulation switch is on.

data.eco_cooling_limit: Eco cooling limit (°C; no motion in the zone)
data.setpoint_max_offset: Room regulation: maximum setpoint correction of an indoor unit (°C)
data.setpoint_interval_seconds: Room regulation: minimum time between setpoint changes (seconds)

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: One room with its temperature sensor, indoor units (existing climate entities) and outdoor unit group. Disable a central choice to enter local values in the next step. The room gets its own Zonentra thermostat; its indoor units are only switched once its Room regulation switch is on.

data.vane_entity: Vane (optional; select, number or switch entity of the indoor unit)
data.vane_cool_value: Vane when cooling (up): option, number, or on/off for a switch
data.vane_heat_value: Vane when heating (down): option, number, or on/off for a switch

menu_options.group: Add or edit an outdoor unit group

zone_details.title: Zone
zone_details.description: Zones use the central configuration by default. Disable a building choice and press Next to enter local values. Existing local values remain available when switching back. Zonentra does not control equipment.

data.name: Name
data.occupancy_entity: Motion sensor (optional; without motion the zone uses the eco band)
data.sensor_validation: Sensor validation (state_based = default; update_based only for periodically reporting sensors)
data.max_age_seconds: Maximum update age for update_based (seconds; ignored by state_based)

group_details.title: Outdoor unit group
group_details.description: The feedback source must report heat, cool or off. Use reliable feedback, not a requested mode. Without feedback the actual mode stays unknown. Every proposal is read-only.

equipment_details.title: Equipment
equipment_details.description: Register each indoor unit (an existing climate entity) as HVAC equipment in its zone; several units per zone and per outdoor unit group are supported. Zonentra only reads mode, hvac_action, temperatures and fan mode. Optional links can be cleared. No equipment is controlled.

data.name: Name
data.entity_id: Physical entity (for HVAC: the indoor unit climate entity)

building.title: Central configuration
building.description: These analysis limits and parameters apply to zones that select building settings. Outdoor temperature always belongs to the whole building. Older outdoor sources still awaiting a choice: {outdoor_candidates}. No equipment is controlled. Manual override and anti-cycling settings only affect the simulated control plan; Zonentra 0.5 sends no commands.
